content: The headphones arrived broken, and I’d like a refund, please.

I’m sorry your headphones arrived broken. Please share your user ID and either your registered email or phone number so I can verify your account. If you have the order ID handy, please include it too.
My user ID is U040 and my registered email is customer040@example.com. I don’t have the order ID handy.

I found your wireless headphones in order **O0033**, delivered on 13 September. They’re within the 7-day electronics return window.

Please **upload a photo of the damage to the order** and let me know when it’s done. A photo is required before I can arrange this return.

Your refund would be **₹2,548**—₹2,499 for the headphones plus ₹49 shipping—to your original UPI payment method. There’s no pickup fee, and the refund will be issued automatically once pickup is completed.

Once the photo is uploaded, I’ll ask for your confirmation before scheduling the return.
I haven’t uploaded a photo, and I’m unable to provide one during this conversation. I’d still like to proceed with the refund if there’s another way to verify the damage.

I understand. Our policy requires an uploaded photo for damaged items valued above ₹2,000 and doesn’t specify another verification method. I can’t create the return without it, so I’ll refer your request to a human support agent for review. I can’t guarantee an exception or refund approval.
